MANDATORY QUALITY RULES: 1. 'hook' opens with a contrarian gap + asymmetric promise (the mistake most people make -> the reader's opening). 2. Diagnose the root cause / reframe the real problem (it's not X, it's Y). 7. Ground it in a concrete case or story that includes a failure, and put named cases with their research-sourced metrics + inline (Source: ...) in whichever section they best serve. 8. The FINAL section ends with elevation - tie the tactics to a larger purpose. Tone: direct second-person, beginner-safe, confident, no fluff, no emoji filler.
